themes.title: Electoral Volatility and Internal Friction Facing Right-Wing Parties
themes.blurb: Right-wing populist parties across several nations are experiencing electoral headwinds, polling drops, and procedural friction ahead of upcoming elections. In Sweden, the Sweden Democrats suffer widespread municipal declines stemming from internal turbulence, while in the US, MAGA strategists face significant legal defeats in court regarding mail-in voting rules prior to the 2026 midterms.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Suffered unprecedented polling losses across 285 of 290 municipalities following internal turbulence and voter disappointment

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Encountered major legal setbacks as the US Supreme Court blocked federal attempts to restrict mail-in voting ahead of midterms

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Navigates local candidate popularity challenges and local coalition dynamics despite broader national momentum

themes.title: Populist Economic Relief Promises and Tax Cuts Ahead of Elections
themes.blurb: Right-wing leaders and parties are emphasizing direct economic relief, tax reductions, and targeted deregulation to address living costs and court working-class support. From fuel tax reduction pushes in Norway to housing deregulation proposals in France and fossil fuel support in the US, right-wing platforms focus heavily on reducing federal burdens.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Pushed cross-party initiatives to lower fuel taxes to alleviate consumer energy expenses

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Proposed repealing mandatory SRU social housing quotas to grant municipalities fiscal and developmental flexibility

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Rolled back power plant regulations and released targeted agricultural tax credit guidance to protect energy jobs

themes.title: Right-Wing Mainstreaming and Power Consolidation Ahead of Key Elections
themes.blurb: Populist right-wing movements are attempting to solidify institutional leverage and broaden their governing credibility ahead of local and national contests. Parties in France, Norway, and Sweden are recalibrating local strategies to win over municipal officials and ensure flexibility for future governing coalitions.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen courts local municipal mayors by advocating for the dismantling of national housing mandates

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Projects municipal gains while refraining from rigid coalition ultimatums to maximize governance leverage

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Attempts to maintain coalition leverage within Sweden's governing bloc while defending regional strongholds
